note: Botswana: nationals of the countries and territories listed enter without a visa for up to 90 days in any 365 (some for 30 at a time, the mark lost in the copy); everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 12 August 2021). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Botswana
sources.said: Visitors to Botswana must obtain an e-Visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Botswana without a visa for up to 90 days within any 365-day period (unless otherwise stated): All European Union member states Angola Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Bahamas Bahrain Barbados Belize Brazil Brunei Canada Chile Costa Rica Cuba Dominica Dominican Republic Eswatini Gambia Grenada Guyana Hong Kong Iceland Israel Jamaica Japan Kenya Kiribati Kuwait Lesotho Liechtenstein Malawi Malaysia Maldives Mauritius Mexico Monaco Mozambique Namibia Nauru New Zealand Norway Oman Papua New Guinea Paraguay Peru Qatar Russia Samoa Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Saudi Arabia Seychelles Sierra Leone Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea South Sudan Switzerland Tanzania Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Turkey Tuvalu Uganda United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Vanuatu Vatican City Venezuela Zambia Zimbabwe
